title: Art. 3.62 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 3 - Entry and Departure of Persons and Their Baggage, M. Identification and entry of crew and other aircraft operators' personnel, 3.62
content: If Contracting States issue Crew Member Certificates, then these shall be issued only in the form of machine readable cards in accordance with the specifications of Doc 9303, Part 5.
